propositions: scc_loc adapter must invoke scc binary via subprocess.run with --format json flag and parse two-level JSON structure (language groups containing per-file entries) to extract Code and Location fields
parsed LOC payload must have structure {"files": {<repo-relative-POSIX-path>: <code-count>}, "max_loc": <max-value>} with normalized relative paths as keys
adapter must fail closed by returning Unavailable(reason, _ACCRUING_SINCE) and logging warning when scc binary is missing, exits non-zero, produces empty stdout, or returns unparseable JSON
adapter must return AnalyzerResult with empty files dict and max_loc=0 (not Unavailable) when scc successfully returns empty JSON array indicating no source files
adapter implementation scc_loc.py must remain self-contained in analyzers/ package, avoiding import from rebar.grounding layer to preserve clean separation from metrics<->grounding dependency
injectable run parameter enables unit tests to avoid requiring live scc binary while proving parse, missing-binary, bad-output, and empty-tree behaviors
